objectives.statement: Explain displacement, velocity, and acceleration and how graphs of motion relate to each other.
Solve projectile and constant-acceleration problems using kinematic equations.
Explain inertia and how net force determines acceleration in Newton's three laws.
Draw free-body diagrams and solve dynamics problems including friction and inclined planes.
Explain work, kinetic and potential energy, and conservation of mechanical energy.
Apply work-energy principles and calculate power in physical systems.
Explain impulse, momentum conservation, and elastic versus inelastic collisions.
Solve collision and explosion problems using conservation of momentum.
Explain torque, rotational inertia, and angular momentum and their linear analogs.
Solve problems involving torque balance, rotational kinematics, and angular momentum conservation.
Explain restoring forces and energy exchange in springs and pendulums.
Calculate periods and predict motion for oscillating systems.
Explain density, pressure, buoyancy, and Bernoulli's principle in static and moving fluids.
Solve buoyancy and fluid-flow problems using Archimedes' principle and continuity.
